# P03 Regulatory Gap Analysis: Cris Santos Company | Chemical | Sole Proprietorship

**Regulation to analyze:** CFATS RBPS 8 (Cyber) - as voluntary benchmark, 6 CFR 27.230(a)(8)
**Why:** Although unenforceable since the July 2023 lapse, RBPS 8 remains the only chemical-sector-specific federal cyber performance standard and is likely to return if CFATS is reauthorized. MTSA-regulated chemical terminals should instead gap against 33 CFR 101 Subpart F (binding).

**Applicability check first:** at this size the business is a specialty chemical distributor (broker). Decide whether CFATS RBPS 8 (Cyber) - as voluntary benchmark applies directly or only through contracts. If it does not apply, analyze the regulation that governs this business, and record the reasoning.
